title: synthesis technique category schema
description: Techniques that create or modify a sample: vapor deposition, solution processing, bulk growth and post-processing such as annealing. tier3, type and subtype are each drawn from the branch's vocabulary; tying subtype to type (so that a sputtering subtype cannot sit under chemical vapor deposition) is the job of the leaf files a later phase adds, one per narrowing, as models_category does.
